plainText:
William P. Kametz (March 22, 1987 — June 9, 2022) was an American voice actor for the English dub of .

==Biography==
Kametz was born on March 22, 1987 in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons and dubbed anime. Kametz joined the during , where he voiced recurring character Ren, along with 's Rotom Phone. On June 11, 2022, it was announced he had passed away two days prior due to complications with stage IV colon cancer. A dedication to him appears in the credits of It's All in the Name! on Netflix.
